statements.impact_statement: Trivy reports fastmcp 3.4.4 and fastmcp-slim 3.4.4 in this exact image; the fixed release is 3.4.10 or later in the compatible major line. Vulnerable authorization behavior was not individually assessed.
statements.action_statement: Reconcile the FastMCP lock to a compatible fixed release, rerun the complete test suite and stdio smoke, then rebuild and issue a new image-specific assessment. This statement is not a waiver.

statements.impact_statement: Trivy reports litellm 1.93.0 in this exact image; the fixed version on this release line is 1.93.2. Exposure to the authenticated SSRF and credential-exposure path was not individually assessed.
statements.action_statement: Upgrade LiteLLM to a compatible fixed release, validate provider and research tests, then rebuild and issue a new image-specific assessment. This statement is not a waiver.

statements.impact_statement: Trivy reports setuptools 83.0.0 in this exact image; the fixed version is 84.1.0. The advisory is Windows-path-specific, but no exception is claimed from platform scoping without a separate approved assessment.
